evidence: From atomic force microscopy (AFM) the root mean square value for the surface roughness was derived as 4.5 nm. For the 42 nm film it was observed that at 450 °C in He the crystallization started within less than 10 min, while the integrated peak intensity slowly increased during the first 30 min. The XRD pattern was captured every 5 s with a linear V antec detector, having a range in 2θ of 20°. The XRD spectra of an O3-grown ALD films, the same film annealed for 30 min in He and a film grown by an O2-plasma enhanced ALD process with long plasma exposure.
